review_boundary: Operational publication policy, not legal advice. Absence of a clear redistribution grant is treated as no permission to redistribute raw records.

BINANCE_EXCHANGE_MARKET_DATA.access_kind: exchange API accessed through CCXT, public USD-M futures websocket market streams (forced-liquidation orders), and the public bulk archive data.binance.vision (daily spot klines)
BINANCE_EXCHANGE_MARKET_DATA.permitted_release: code, query specification, symbols, timestamps, hashes and derived non-row-level results

Raw rows remain withheld and external publication requires a final provider or qualified-rights confirmation. Re-reviewed on 2026-09-15 for the liquidation stream: the Binance FZE Terms of Use (updated 5 January 2026; the VARA-licensed entity for Dubai residents) license Binance IP only as needed to use the services for non-commercial personal or internal business use (clause 25), and clause 27(m), paraphrased, bars copying, downloading, storing, publishing or creating derivative works of that intellectual property. Re-reviewed on 2026-09-21: the Binance FZE Terms of Use still show Last Updated 5 January 2026, with the same licence limited to non-commercial personal or internal business use and the same prohibition on creating derivative works of Binance intellectual property. Decision unchanged. Route added 2026-09-23: daily spot klines from Binance's public bulk archive (data.binance.vision, documented in the github.com/binance/binance-public-data repository), for the research that would hedge perpetual funding carry with the same coin's spot price. The repository's MIT licence covers its code, not the market data, which stays under the Binance terms above: raw rows withheld, derived publication not cleared, storage for internal research recorded as unresolved. Ingestion note: from 2025-01-01 the archive's spot kline timestamps are in microseconds, not milliseconds.

BYBIT_EXCHANGE_MARKET_DATA.access_kind: public v5 REST and websocket market data read without an account (funding-rate history; allLiquidation stream)
BYBIT_EXCHANGE_MARKET_DATA.permitted_release: code, subscription specification, symbols, timestamps, session coverage, hashes and derived non-row-level results
BYBIT_EXCHANGE_MARKET_DATA.portable_reproduction_route: none for liquidations, which the venue does not archive; a reviewer can only compare forward coverage from the start of their own collection
BYBIT_EXCHANGE_MARKET_DATA.terms_evidence: The API Terms and Conditions page renders only in a browser and could not be read by the 2026-09-15 review. Search-engine text, unverified, describes bans on repackaging or reselling the services, API or Service Data, on commercial exploitation of the APIs, and on benchmarking; no publication grant was found. Raw rows are withheld, derived publication is not cleared, and the review stays incomplete until the terms are read in full. The Service-Restricted-Countries page (updated 2026-09-01) excludes Dubai for Bybit Virtual Asset Platform Operator LLC only and does not say which entity serves a Dubai resident. Read in full on 2026-09-23: the API Terms and Conditions page ("Last updated: 2026-01-16 12:05:57") embeds a seven-page PDF, https://www.bybit.com/common-static/compliance/legal/BYBIT/df1923006718fbba8ba70d7d762b9866.pdf, SHA-256 b8d683cd72616774f1d1fce231d2d8e3bad8bac912dafd5e532c1d8cbf5a11eb, rendered by a real browser because the page refuses automated HTTP/2 clients. Paraphrased: clause 3.1 defines Service Data as any data given by using the API; clause 5.1 grants a limited, revocable licence to use the APIs for the user's own Use and no rights over intellectual property in content reached through them; clause 6.6 bars using the API to monitor its availability or performance for benchmarking; clause 6.7 bars repackaging or reselling the services, the API or Service Data under any circumstances; clause 6.9 bars commercial exploitation of the APIs; clause 9.2 reserves to Bybit all rights in the output of the APIs. Decision: collection and storage for internal paper research is within the licensed Use; raw rows are never published or redistributed (6.7); the collector's session records exist to exclude gaps from its own dataset, not to benchmark the API (6.6); derived results stay not cleared for publication (9.2); and any use in a funded book or a paid data product is commercial exploitation (6.9) that needs Bybit's written consent first. The entity question for a Dubai resident recorded above is unchanged.
